answer: Attackers must acquire many scarce tokens at rising cost, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. Sybil resistance works by requiring each agent to stake a unique jade token minted only through a verified proof-of-personhood ceremony, then slashing that stake if duplicate identities surface. Honest participants who wander between tasks keep reputation tied to one identity, while forged duplicates find no orchard of rewards to harvest. From sa0007's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
